raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "lsapy" %}
{% set version = "0.4.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/lsapy-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f7f716f09b09508275a1ff907ad0d75b01c1dce22e92f566c0323b4da437f592

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - flit-core >=3.11,<4
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - geopandas >=0.14.0
    - numpy >=1.26.0
    - pandas >=2.2.0
    - pooch >=1.8.2
    - regionmask >=0.13.0
    - scipy >=1.15.0
    - xarray >=2024.10.0

test:
  imports:
    - lsapy
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/baptistehamon/lsapy
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Python package for Land Suitability Analysis.
  doc_url: https://lsapy.readthedocs.io
  dev_url: https://github.com/baptistehamon/lsapy

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - baptistehamon
